scores.tell: Small hero floating in tall purple field with big empty margins top and bottom. Real cards fill more of the card.
Hero is a wide pool filling the lower frame, with the fence and grass as a busy scene. Reads as an illustration, not an object-on-backdrop card. The duck is a small focal point.
Wagon is cropped small and sits in a full landscape scene with sky and hills. There is competing background, and no single hero with clear separation.
Phone booth is centered and fills the height well, but it sits on a flat floor/wall split with a tidy pattern backdrop. Slightly too tidy and symmetric.
Pier and lifebuoy are pushed to the top with the ocean taking more than half the card. The hero is off-center and the water competes.
Large flippers fill the card at a diagonal with a clean concentric backdrop. Margins and scale match the real cards (towel, whistle). Almost none.
Gloves fill the lower two-thirds, with the wood floor taking half the card. Slightly low and heavy, but the scale is good.
Tilted pair fills the card with tight margins on a striped backdrop. This matches the real card framing.
Boot is tall and leaves empty space to the right and below. The placement is slightly left-heavy with loose bottom margin. Compare the lesson boot, which fills the card.
Broom runs diagonally edge to edge with strong scale, like the towel and whistle. Very slight crop of the bristle tip at the lower left.
